title: Mass Preface Dialogue (Sursum Corda)
text:
PRIEST: The Lord be with you.
PEOPLE: And with your spirit.

PRIEST: Lift up your hearts.
PEOPLE: We lift them up to the Lord.

PRIEST: Let us give thanks to the Lord our God.
PEOPLE: It is right and just.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).

translation.latin: Dominus vobiscum. / Et cum spiritu tuo. / Sursum corda. / Habemus ad Dominum. / Gratias agamus Domino Deo nostro. / Dignum et iustum est.
